lastCheckpoint.note: Contaminated by my own commit: I pushed bin/_toolchain-path.sh mid-run as a throwaway "wip" commit so the Mac could pull it and prove the probe distinguished shim from install. That moved HEAD and invalidated the baseline. Fourth occurrence today of a run participating in what it observes. The work itself is verified: toolchain-path-test 5/5 with mutations for the scratch-HOME probe, version ordering and word-splitting; device-verify-test 17/17 after stubbing the new gate; ai-learn-test on macOS went FAIL to PASS. The "wip" commit is a second, separate mistake — a message that says nothing, pushed to a public repository.
